title: Travel Speed Solenoid Hot Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a hot short circuit in the travel speed selector solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • None in particular. • If the cause of the failure disappears, the machine becomes normal by itself.
machine_effect: The machine travels fast in Lo travel speed setting. (The machine monitor shows Lo setting but the speed is kept at around Hi.)
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the travel speed selector solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is a short circuit.) (Code: 02300)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of the inspection method, see “RELA- TED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Disconnect connector V04. 3. Connect the T-adapter to the female side of connector V04. 4. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 5. Measure the voltage. 6. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? Stand- Measuring point and measurement Item ard valcondition ue Max Voltage Between V04 (female) (1) and (2) 4.5V

branches.YES: • The wiring harness has no hot short circuits. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The wiring harness has a hot short circuit. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the inspection above again. 2. Have you identified the cause when the inspection is done again?

branches.NO: • The pump controller can be defective. • Replace the pump controller. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
